newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.001pts to 101.507.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.001pts to 101.507.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.001 points in Wednesday's trading to 101.507, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.504 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.014 points to 97.704, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.376 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 0.029 points to 1,120.788.
